status: Stronger physical passage-wind design under evaluation; retain all outcomes
design_note: Two monitoring bays in the west, separated by a staggered column cluster with multiple passages. The eastern yard contains reachable service aisles but no monitoring target. All free-space cells retain clarity dynamics. A zero background target is an explicit task definition, as in Scenario 3, not a method-specific cost or exclusion. All methods begin with the same spatial unknown-wind prior over the complete environment.

wind_design.status: Candidate physical boundary specification; regenerate CFD before any robot tests

task_passage.intent: Oppose B-to-A transit through the short diagonal gap; retain a physically traversable alternative around the western column.

remote_yard.intent: Spatially varying flow in the eastern service aisles, irrelevant to the short monitoring alternatives but included in global learning.

boundary_proposal.note: Physical boundary-condition proposal for a covered inspection yard. Inlet vectors must be normalized by the CFD setup. All other boundaries remain no-slip. Peak inlet speeds are not robot-plane wind speeds. These ports have not been simulated.

wind_design.acceptance_targets: Test for collision of wind-unaware unfiltered MBD and substantial delay or stalling with the unchanged execution RPCBF. Preserve calm monitoring bays, a weaker-wind western alternative and connected eastern yard. Acceptance depends on actual CFD and recorded trials, never on assigned outcome labels.
wind_design.generation: Use the existing 3-D D3Q19 MRT / Smagorinsky solver and a frozen stationary vector mean. Configure physical boundary inlets/outlets and verify the resulting passage flow; never paint, mask or rescale interior velocities.
wind_design.information: Neither intended wind zone, true velocity nor support mask is supplied to POAM, acquisition, MBD or RPCBF.

revision_reason: v3 increased delay without collision; v4 repositioned inlet also did not give the required wind-sensitive narrow transit. Retain v3 physical ports and move the eastern column bordering the direct passage from (2.85,3.35,r=.65) to (2.75,3.05,r=.68). The minimum gap remains about .358 m, with the original western alternative and connected eastern yard. Regenerate full CFD around the revised obstacle; every planner/controller/estimator setting remains unchanged.
